name: bongbangla-media
description: BongBangla Media & Creative Agency Website with Supabase & Lovable Integration

scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('js', 'dist/js', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('css', 'dist/css', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('assets', 'dist/assets', {recursive:true, force:false}); try { fs.copyFileSync('favicon.ico', 'dist/favicon.ico'); fs.copyFileSync('favicon.png', 'dist/favicon.png'); } catch(e){}; try { if(fs.existsSync('CNAME')) fs.copyFileSync('CNAME', 'dist/CNAME'); } catch(e){}"
